description: This file defines a custom UI component class 'VerticalLabelUI' that extends BasicLabelUI to render JLabel components with vertical text orientation, supporting both clockwise and counterclockwise rotations.

classes.name: VerticalLabelUI
classes.description: A custom Swing UI component for rendering JLabel with vertical text orientation, supporting clockwise and counterclockwise rotation.

methods.name: VerticalLabelUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI with specified rotation direction.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the label, swapping width and height for vertical orientation.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Handles the custom painting of the label, rotating graphics context to render vertical text and icon.
